messages:
Sam: Kickoff for ZenithFlux POC perf. Sales goal: prove 2.8k sustained qps for their short-chat route, p99 < 200ms, demonstrate burst recovery and show costing for burst-minutes vs commit. Requested window: Wed 09:30 PT, 90m. Also ask: BYOK/HSM options and lead times.

Ivy: I can own load harness and runbook. Need prompt mix, streaming ratio, and whether to exercise tokenized path. Also confirm hosted vs temp dedicated fallback.

Sam: Prompt mix in prospect packet: 72% short (~30 toks), 23% medium (~130), 5% long (~420). Streaming ratio 1:5. Test hosted first; fallback to dedicated pool if GPU saturation. Auth = API key for hosted; service account for dedicated. Security questionnaire due Tue EOD.

Ben: Ops note: staging has 5x A10G free; can reserve 7 for the window with capacity ok. Private HSM/BYOK import needs ~48-72h for peering and certs. Hosted KMS envelope flow is immediate. If we need Dedicated temp pool, I can spin it but need approval now.

Ivy: Proposed runs:
- Ramp 0->2.8k over 12m, hold 40m steady
- Burst sequence: three 20s spikes to 8.4k qps with 2m recovery
- Cache priming churn: spawn 10k cold sessions over 10m
I'll use vegeta for qps and a small Locust streaming profile.

Ivy: Example vegeta command (full bodies in repo):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=2800 -duration=40m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=hdr
```
We'll add X-Run-ID and X-Trace headers and include cost tokens headers.

Sam: Acceptance criteria draft: p99(short+med) <=200ms during steady window, error rate <0.4%, tail recovery <90s after bursts, and sustained throughput within 5% of target for 75% of steady time. Collect p50/p90/p99, errors, GPU occupancy, queue backlog, and tokenized cost.

sec-bot: Expected security asks: HSM attestation (FIPS), KMS envelope docs, BYOK import steps & lead time, audit log retention, SOC2. If ZenithFlux insists on an HSM in Private, ops lead time ~72h.

Ben: Capacity request submitted for 7x A10G Wed 08:00-12:00 PT. Pending approval. Will enable kernel tracing and detailed GPU metrics.

Ivy: I'll push the runbook + scripts to perf/zenithflux and post link here. I'll also prepare a tokens->cost quicksheet showing hosted on-demand vs a Dedicated commit example and explicit burst-overage calc.

Sam: For pricing messaging: show hosted on-demand estimate, Dedicated commit example that reduces unit cost, and clear burst overage math (per burst-minute). Also explain graceful degradation options (smaller model variant fallback).

Ben: Capacity approved for 7x A10G. Added note: if we see high queuing, enable prefix caching and model-shard fallback.

Ivy: :white_check_mark: run scripts pushed, validating prompt mix locally. Will post pre-run checklist 24h out.

sec-bot: :white_check_mark: security bullets drafted and attached; noted HSM lead times.

Sam: Thanks team  we'll use this thread for run artifacts and the final writeup.
